meta.name: JOPPE Tech Commerce & PC Builder (Sky Blue Light Theme)
meta.description: High-performance tech e-commerce identity featuring a clean, luminous Sky Blue and Clean Light canvas, 90-degree boxy flat architecture, fresh sky blue accents (#0284C7 / #0EA5E9), and tactile mechanical microinteractions.

primary.role: Fresh Sky Blue primary branding, prominent CTA buttons, active slot borders, and logo badges

secondary.role: Vivid Sky Blue top utility bar, search action, and secondary highlights

accent.role: Crimson Red sale badges, cart item counters, and deletion triggers

neutral.usage: Deep slate values (#0F172A, #1E293B) for primary titles and technical parameters ensuring crystal-clear WCAG AAA readability; mid slate (#475569, #64748B) for labels; light neutrals (#CBD5E1 down to #FFFFFF) construct crisp, luminous boxy surfaces and borders

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast clean tech light mode with deep slate text on crisp white surfaces and sky blue highlights (WCAG AAA compliant)

typography.font_style_notes: Sharp monospace badges for technical branding and IDs; geometric sans-serif with bold letter-spacing for module titles; clear humanist sans for product specs

spacing.section_rhythm: Consistent 8px to 12px vertical gaps between modular cards; 1px dividing lines with zero rounded offsets

layout.grid_system: 12-column responsive fluid grid on desktop; single-column stacked modular cards on mobile

shape.border_usage: Pure 90-degree boxy flat architecture (BorderRadius.zero). Every container has a crisp 1px to 1.5px tech border (#CBD5E1 or #0EA5E9 on active)

elevation.depth_cues: Crisp borders, subtle sky elevation tints (#E0F2FE), and overlapping rectangular blocks rather than heavy dark shadows

iconography.preferred_set: Material Symbols Sharp / Custom Tech HUD Glyphs

motion.entrance_pattern: instant scale-in (0.97 to 1.0) with zero blur lag
motion.exit_pattern: snappy collapse with linear opacity fade
motion.philosophy: Mechanical switch tactile precision (TactilePress with 80ms down / 140ms up curve and haptic selection click)

components.button_style: Sharp rectangular button with 1px border, uppercase bold text, zero radius, and tactile scale press
components.input_style: Rectangular light gray box (#F1F5F9) with 1px border (#CBD5E1), crisp monospace placeholder, sky blue focus outline
components.card_style: Flat 90-degree pure white panel (#FFFFFF) with 1px border (#CBD5E1), modular padding, and sky blue corner brackets
components.navigation_pattern: Horizontal scrollable chips with zero radius and active sky blue indicator bars
components.modal_style: Bottom sheet with square corners, sky blue header ribbon, and draggable scrollable sheet
components.list_style: Separated cards with 8px to 10px spacing and 1px dividers
components.component_notes: Strict 90-degree aesthetic applied to buttons, badges, chips, search inputs, modal sheets, and image frames

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Cleanroom semiconductor laboratory & modern engineering avionics display
aesthetic.era_influence: 2026+ Clean Tech & Fresh Azure Hardware Design
aesthetic.genre: High-Tech Minimalist & Sky Blue Boxy Flat E-Commerce

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous clean spacing on luminous background with intentional 10px-14px micro-spacing inside cards
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: solid bottom summary bar with crisp floating top headers and prominent price badges
visual_language.focal_strategy: sky blue and crimson focal points directing attention to prices, active hardware slots, and AI recommendations
visual_language.texture_usage: subtle diagonal cyber grid lines and clean sky shimmer gradient sweep

composition.hierarchy_method: color weight & scale contrast (sky blue price tags > bold black titles > slate specs)
composition.flow_direction: vertical slot progression with horizontal subcategory filtering
composition.negative_space_role: luminous separator ensuring effortless legibility across dense hardware specs

imagery.photo_treatment: crisp alpha-isolated hardware product renders against transparent or clean light backdrop with zero drop-shadow bleed
imagery.illustration_style: schematic vector outlines and isometric hardware diagrams
imagery.graphic_elements: 90-degree HUD corner brackets (10px stroke), monospace version chips, and wattage meter bars
imagery.pattern_usage: diagonal grid mesh painter on image fallbacks and tech shimmer sweep
imagery.image_shape: strict rectangular 1:1 or 16:9 boxes with 1px solid tech border

interaction_feel.feedback_style: tactile click with physical haptic impulse on every touch
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: instant border color shift to #0EA5E9 and background shift to #F0F9FF with 0.98 scale compression
interaction_feel.loading_style: tech shimmer with 1400ms repeat cycle and diagonal sky blue beam sweep

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: authoritative tech enthusiast, knowledgeable, concise, and gamer-attuned
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative (CHỌN, BỎ CHỌN, TIẾN HÀNH THANH TOÁN, XÂY DỰNG CẤU HÌNH)
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: informative diagnostic message with fallback action button
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: precise and actionable (e.g. 'Công suất nguồn không đủ tải', 'Vui lòng chọn linh kiện')

overview.fallback_strategy: graceful static boxy borders and solid colors on lower-end devices
overview.primary_technology: Flutter CustomPainter, AnimationController, LinearGradient shaders, and HapticFeedback

background_effects.description: Clean fresh sky gradient with ambient soft blue glow in hero sections

particle_systems.description: Particle systems disabled in primary catalog for maximum 120fps scrolling smoothness

3d_elements.description: 3D canvas disabled in core app views; isolated 2D isometric renders used instead

shader_effects.description: Sky shimmer gradient sweep and wattage bar live interpolation shaders

text_effects.description: High-clarity static rendering with strict letter-spacing and monospaced digits for prices

cursor_effects.description: Native mobile touch interface; web desktop uses system arrow with pointer hover highlights

image_effects.description: Fallback HUD box with CustomPainter corner brackets and cyber shimmer sweep

canvas_drawings.description: _CyberGridPainter drawing 90-degree corner brackets (10px) in sky blue at opposite diagonal corners

svg_animations.description: Vector icons rendered via Flutter IconData (MaterialIcons)

visual_effects.composite_notes: The Joppe UI achieves its high-tech identity through architectural discipline: 100% strict 90-degree geometry (BorderRadius.zero), fresh sky blue surfaces (#F8FAFC canvas, #FFFFFF cards, #F0F9FF active tint) contrasted with sharp 1px sky blue borders (#0EA5E9), deep slate typography (#0F172A) for effortless legibility, tactile mechanical button compression (80ms tactile press + haptic click), dynamic wattage safety meters, and clean sky shimmer loading effects.
